name: Mozambique
kernel_gaps: withholding table with per-dependant columns and '-' cells (local Row type; Table.Row has one value)

validation.referee: statute's own printed tables and amounts (Lean #guard / decide)
validation.notes: build phase: no referee values used

sources: Lei n.º 20/2013, de 23 de Setembro (BR I Série n.º 76), arts. 1-5 and the annex to CIRPS art. 65-A (archived AT copy, table read on the page image)
scale: 729000 MZN (12 x the 60 750 MT monthly limit of the 25 % row)
unsupported: INSS 3 % from the INSS page (the joint ministerial diploma fixing the rate, RSSO art. 15, not reached)
registry_correction: MZ: Código do IRPS (Lei 33/2007, amended by Lei 20/2013); wages bear a final monthly withholding by the art. 65-A table (10-32 % by dependants).
headline: Mozambique built from the 2013 IRPS withholding table (final for wages): 10-32 % with five dependant columns; the gazetted table prints 27.275,00 instead of 28.275,00 for three dependants, so tax falls by 1 000 MT a month at 144 750 MT (annual tax 339 300 vs 327 300).

w5_pattern_a.added: INSS worker 3 % of remuneration (no ceiling), reported, not deducted (AT FAQ: no deduction for 1st-category income, CIRPS art. 29)
w5_pattern_a.provision: INSS page "Taxa contributiva TCO" (inss.gov.mz, fetched 2026-11-20): worker 3 % + employer 4 % = 7 %; official secondary; RSSO (Decreto 51/2017, republished by Decreto 56/2024 de 30 de Julho) arts. 14-15; AT "As 100 questões ... sobre o CIRPS" (2015) q. 25
w5_pattern_a.switch: "w5Contrib": false restores the pre-W5 outputs (0 / 300 random households differ)
